model.objective: maximize the minimum intensity over every point of the unit square

coordinate_encoding: Interpret JSON and 17-significant-digit CSV decimals using nearest IEEE-754 binary64; points_hex gives the exact rational coordinates in hexadecimal floating-point notation. x right, y up.
comparison_caveat: Published trailing-plus values are rounded lower thresholds; a positive difference is not proof of beating undisclosed exact coordinates. Unlisted n has no comparison baseline.
